question: In a certain code language, "123" means "hot filtered coffee", "356" means "very hot day" and "589" means "day and night”. Which digit means “very"?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54b9307361642d4f48646f7ef4721709bedab45d65389d9d5a71666ab673ea1.png] 

From the above Diagram,

"3" means Hot.

"5" means Day.

"6" means Very.

So, very is coded as 6

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
